mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate at or below 0.25% indicates an accommodative monetary policy environment that compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate exceeding 10.0% signals severe economic distress and triggers risk-off sentiment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 10.0.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 550 and industrial production below 100 indicate simultaneous contraction in consumer and industrial output, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when HOUST < 550 and INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 3.0% signals active monetary tightening, increasing discount rates for equity valuation and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 3.0.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 100 (index) indicates manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate earnings growth and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 550 and retail sales below 350,000 million dollars indicate weakening consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when HOUST < 550 and RSAFS < 350000.

mechanism_narrative: CPI index above 217.0 signals rising inflation, prompting fears of central bank tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 217.0.

mechanism_narrative: GDP growth above 13,000 billion dollars indicates strong economic expansion, supporting positive equity returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when GDPC1 > 13000.
